justification: The only common ground is that both surfaces involve highly schematic human-derived forms and simple linear motifs, which is about as generic as iconographic overlap gets. A shows a single monolithic anthropomorphic body covered with static abstract geometry (concentric circles, arcs, banded chevrons) with no narrative, while B is a lively narrative scene of many running stick-like hunters converging on a huge profile stag and a bovid — different subjects, different relationships, different composition.
